_note: UI strings for the translation workbench. Key names are fixed in code; missing entries fall back to the default language. {0} {1} are placeholders.
name: Translation workbench
panel.title: Translation workbench
page.title: Translation workbench
page.confirmReload: There are unsaved changes; switching languages discards them. Continue?
page.detail.hint: Press Ctrl+S when done, or click Save above
page.resizeTitle: Drag up and down to resize the editing area
page.rootFallback: ⚠ No extension repository in this workspace — editing the **local installed copy**: {0}. Changes are useless to others and are lost when the extension updates; open the repository folder that contains src/features/pyrois/data/docs instead
prompt.locale: Directory name of the new language (like vi-VN, ja-JP). Every file gets the full structure with empty values
prompt.localeBad: Wrong format — should look like zh-CN, en-US, vi-VN
notice.noRepo: The translation workbench is a **developer tool**: it only works in a workspace with the extension repository open — no folder containing src/features/pyrois/data/docs was found. It edits the repository's text files, not the local installed copy (editing that one is useless to others and is lost on update).
notice.keyNotFound: "{0}" is not in the {1} file yet (the file was opened)
page.jumpHint: Double-click to jump to this entry in the {0} file (or use the right-click menu)
page.openTargetTitle: Open the translation file that holds this key in the editor and jump to that line
page.openSourceTitle: Open the source-language file and jump to that line
notice.partial: Saved {0} file(s); {1} entry(ies) were not written ({2})
notice.noneWritten: No file was written; {1} entry(ies) were not written ({2})
reason.no-file: the target file does not exist
reason.no-key: the target file has no such key
reason.no-group: the target language has no such struct
notice.localeAdded: Added {0}: created/filled {1} file(s) with empty values (same structure as the default language)
sync.none: Other languages are already in sync with {0}
sync.preview: Copy the keys of {0} to the other languages?
sync.removedHint: These keys exist in other languages but not in the default one (possibly missing there; check before deleting):
section.docs: Documentation (long text shown in hovers / completion)
section.ui: UI strings (buttons, messages and other short text)
section.manifest: Manifest text (settings page / command names / extension name)
